service_account_key_ref.description: 1Password reference to the service-account JSON (op://<vault>/<item>/<field>). NEVER a raw secret per ADMINISTRATEME_BUILD.md §L1.

oauth_credentials_ref.description: macOS Keychain reference to installed-user OAuth credentials.

user_email.description: The Gmail address being polled (subject of service-account domain-wide delegation).

provider_account_id.description: Exact reviewed provider account coordinate; must match user_email.

member_id.description: The one household member who owns this mailbox. Unbound mailboxes are not exposed in Comms.

service_principal_id.description: Exact non-human owner for a reviewed CoS service mailbox.

workspace.description: Isolation coordinate retained on every message fact.

permission_scope.description: Exact provider permission set reviewed for this account binding.

binding_provenance.description: How the provider account subject was established.

ownership_attested.description: Explicit owner attestation that this account belongs to member_id in workspace.

account_label.description: Optional member-visible label; never used for routing.

enable_writes.description: Request Gmail modify/send scopes and expose reply/read/archive actions. Requires fresh OAuth consent.

channel_id.description: Reviewed service channel whose trusted route table resolves direct intake.

trusted_sender_routes.description: Exact authenticated sender metadata to reviewed opaque route keys; content and display names are never consulted.

initial_backfill_days.description: Bounded recent-history fill window after private seeds and related expansion. Zero disables only the recent fill; incremental history remains enabled.

initial_backfill_max_messages.description: Global hard cap across historical seeds, related expansion, and recent fill. Zero disables initial history acquisition.

historical_seed_queries.description: Private member-reviewed Gmail searches that acquire older named matters before generic recency. Query text is never emitted in events or status.

historical_seed_max_messages_per_query.description: Per-seed hard cap inside the global initial_backfill_max_messages ceiling.

historical_related_max_participants.description: Maximum distinct non-member seed participants used for deterministic historical context acquisition.

historical_related_messages_per_particip.description: Per-participant context cap inside the global acquisition ceiling.

historical_related_context_days.description: Days before and after the seed matter searched for exact participant references. Zero removes the date window while retaining the other caps.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor (e.g. law-practice email = 'privileged') but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
